decisions.reason: With the combined robot withdrawn, the dedicated de-shuttering robot is the firm's main automated de-shuttering module, and industry growth provides slack to keep it while it builds a track record.
The profile storage robot supports the shuttering and de-shuttering robots in automated pallet circulation, and no shortfall against aspiration calls for problemistic search.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's strategy for automated, future-ready precast production and fits its engineering strengths.
The newly launched multi-model magazining, cleaning and plotting line extends the firm's established offer and is too young to judge against aspiration, so slack lets the firm carry it.
Production analysis software costs little to maintain and strengthens the integrated lifecycle and uptime offering, so it is worth keeping.
